entries.title: A keyboard preset with a prefix key
entries.body: Settings, Keyboard offers one more preset, modeled on a popular terminal tool: the default preset's plain letter keys for moving around, plus a prefix key, Control+B, that works anywhere, even in the middle of a sentence. Press the prefix, then N or P for the next or previous card, Z to maximize a card, D to put it aside, an arrow to move to that part of the window, or a colon to search commands. You change the prefix in one place, the new Prefix row, and every key that starts with it moves along.

picture.alt: Keyboard settings with the new preset chosen in the Preset row, the Prefix row below it showing Control+B with Record and Reset, and Search commands listing Control+B then colon among its keys
